About Space Education

A neighbourhood coaching institute built on one simple idea: students do well when the basics are strong and practice is regular.

Space Education, on Kalambagh Road in Muzaffarpur, helps school students build strong concepts and steady study habits. Teaching here is paced so that no student is left behind — a topic moves forward only when the class has understood it.

Parents and students can walk in during institute hours, attend a demo class, and then decide. There is no pressure to enrol on the spot — sit in a real batch, meet the teachers, and see the teaching for yourself first.

The institute stays open all seven days, with a short Sunday morning session, so doubt-clearing and revision never have to wait for Monday.

Good to know

  • Demo class — attend before you decide
  • Open 7 days — including Sunday morning
  • On Kalambagh Road — easy to reach from across Muzaffarpur
  • Talk to us directly — call or WhatsApp +91 77799 47341

Why Space Education

Concepts before shortcuts

Every topic starts from the basics and builds up step by step, so students understand the "why" — not just memorised steps that collapse in the exam hall.

Practice, tested regularly

Learning sticks when it is practised. Regular class tests and revision sessions show students exactly where they stand, chapter by chapter.

Doubts are welcome

No question is too small. Students are encouraged to ask until a topic is fully clear — in class, in doubt sessions, or on WhatsApp.

Demo class first

Judge the teaching yourself before joining. Attend a real class, meet the teacher, and only then decide — no pressure, no obligation.

Open all seven days

Classes run Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 8 PM, with a Sunday morning session too — easy to fit around school and family schedules.

Easy to reach

Located on Kalambagh Road in the heart of Muzaffarpur, the institute is a short trip from most neighbourhoods in the city.
